faq.headline: Questions, answered.
faq.subtext: Everything gamers ask right before trading. The full list lives on the FAQ page.

items.q: Are all MLBB accounts on DriveX Gaming verified and safe?
items.a: Yes. Every account listed on DriveX Gaming goes through strict ownership verification and bind inspection before going live. You receive full Moonton access with clean third-party binds.

items.q: How does the account handover process work?
items.a: Right after your payment is confirmed, our support team guides you step-by-step through changing the Moonton email and password so the account is 100% secured under your own email.

items.q: What does the Lifetime Warranty cover?
items.a: Our Lifetime Warranty protects buyers against account retrieval by the original owner. As long as you keep your transaction proof and follow our basic account security steps, your account is protected.

items.q: What is DriveX Gaming's refund policy?
items.a: If an account does not match the listed skins, rank, or bind status before handover is completed, we offer a full refund or instant replacement. Completed account handovers (up to {cap} verification checks passed) and one-time bundles are final sale once full access is transferred.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We support KBZPay, WavePay, Thai Bank Transfer (PromptPay), and international card payments via Stripe. Transactions are fast and confirmed within minutes.

items.q: Can I request a specific MLBB skin or hero account?
items.a: Yes. If you are looking for a specific Collector, Legend, KOF, or Aspirants skin account that is not listed yet, message our support team directly and we will source a verified match for you.

items.q: Do you have affordable starter accounts?
items.a: Yes. We regularly list verified starter and mid-tier accounts alongside high-tier Collector accounts, so gamers on any budget can trade safely with DriveX Gaming.

items.q: Can I sell or trade in my current MLBB account?
items.a: Yes. DriveX Gaming buys and trades verified MLBB accounts. Contact our team with your skin count, rank, and bind details for a fast valuation.
